title: Shinonome Ena — Gloomy Afternoon〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now that we're all here, let's start heading over.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aye aye♪
I can't wait to see this cafe since you recommended, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. We have to walk a little further than we usually do to our usual diner, but it has a nice relaxing atmosphere and their cakes are amazing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, they don't serve ramen, but they do have a few different kinds of pasta on the menu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They do?
I haven't had much pasta lately, so I might get some...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...?
Is it just me or do you seem pretty tired?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Was talking to your dad a bit too much for you...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe... I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All I did today was answer his questions...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But being on edge as you talk to him must've taken its toll...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Being on edge...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're a kind and considerate person, Mafuyu, so I guess you're feeling a little guilty...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, he is spending his free time each week to come and see you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm feeling guilty...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Even if you are, you didn't cause your parents any trouble until now. I wouldn't worry too much about the repercussions.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What she said! I mean, just look at us.
We're causing other people trouble all the time♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I still only go to school when I feel like it. I'm sure there's rumors about me in the neighborhood and they're probably not good ones either...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember the times when I've felt really bad about the trouble I've caused my mom and even  Akito...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In any case, Mafuyu, we know you're doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That being said, no one can keep anything like this up forever. Don't forget that it's okay for you to ask for help from those around you when you're trying to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'll keep that in mind...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're welcome.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That was a really fun after-party...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Kanade even said that she really liked the pasta. I'm glad I suggested that we go to that cafe.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Now then...
I think I'll work on that assignment for art class until its 25:00.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We're supposed to draw a landscape.
What should I do?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I have that book of landscape photos lying around here somewhere that I can use for practice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've mostly been referring to pictures online lately, so it might be nice to use something out of a book for a change.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Let's see...
I'm pretty sure it's somewhere in this closet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Aha! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... There goes all the other books in the stack...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What a pain... But I gotta clean this up otherwise I can't shut my closet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's this postcard?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Ena, your father sent this picture postcard. It looks like he drew that gorge we saw today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I still had this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was still in kindergarten or elementary school...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I used to always look forward to him doing another drawing after returning from wherever he went to visit.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I should only have a couple more of these lying around since he only drew them when he felt like it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honestly, how could I've had so much faith in him?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does he have to be my dad...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And the thought of having to tell him what I want to do with myself moving forward is totally unbearable...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know I have to give that some more thought... But for now, I need to work on my landscape.
